## This module

::: {.fragment .top-space}
> This module will equip you with the knowledge and skills to use maps to
> understand why crime happens in some places more than others
:::

:::: {.fragment .top-space}
… and …

::: {.top-space}

:::

## A typical week


::: {.fragment .top-space}
**Monday--Friday**<br> work through chapters
:::

::: {.fragment .top-space}
**Tuesday**<br> in-person lecture and workshop
:::

::: {.fragment .top-space}
**Friday**<br> write and submit code for weekly practice exercise
:::


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


## Week by week

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
### First half of term

| Week | Topic                    |
|-----:|:-------------------------|
| 1    | Getting started          |
| 2    | Transforming data        |
| 3    | Mapping crime patterns   |
| 4    | Mapping area data        |
| 5    | **Assessment 1**         |
:::

::: {.column width="50%" .fragment}
### Second half of term

| Week | Topic                    |
|-----:|:-------------------------|
| 6    | Handling messy data      |
| 7    | Mapping hotspots         |
| 8    | Mapping without maps     |
| 9    | Mapping change over time |
| 10   | **Assessment 2**         |
:::

::::

::: {.fragment .top-space}
**January**: final assessment
:::


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


## Module assessment

| Type       | Weight | Deadline                 | You will produce …           |
|:-----------|:-------|:-------------------------|:-----------------------------|
| Exam       | 20%    | Tue 3 November           | code to make 2 maps          |
| Exam       | 20%    | Tue 15 December          | code to make a short report  |
| Coursework | 60%    | Thu 14 January           | code to make a longer report |

## How to do well

::: {.fragment .top-space}
**Manage your time**<br> don't try to finish everything in the in-person session
:::

::: {.fragment .top-space}
**Complete all the activities**<br> lectures only cover part of what you need to know
:::

::: {.fragment .top-space}
**Ask lots of questions**<br> easier to do in person than on Moodle
:::

::: {.fragment .top-space}
**Practice**<br> submit each week's exercise before Friday @ 4pm
:::
